main_subject.detail: Two adult women pose in a luxury white walk-in closet: one stands in a taupe/beige halter mini dress with structured bodice, draped train and clear/silver heels; the other crouches in a white halter mini dress with matching structured detailing and silver heels. Keep approved wardrobe references unchanged.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic full-body editorial candid portrait of two adult women in a luxury white walk-in closet. The standing adult woman leans against shelving in a taupe-beige halter mini dress with structured fitted bodice, refined draped train, clear or silver strappy heels, large gold drop earrings, a thin necklace and stacked bracelets. The crouching adult woman poses in profile and looks toward camera, wearing a white halter mini dress with matching structured detailing, silver metallic heels and a diamond bracelet. Surround them with white built-in shelves displaying approved luxury handbags, clutches and gold heels on beige textured carpet. Use direct flash, hard high-contrast lighting, distinct shadows on white walls, realistic skin pores, fabric weave and leather grain, and an exclusive night-out party-prep atmosphere. Keep both subjects clearly adult and fashion-editorial.
